input.topic: Finance cannot split a single payment across two invoices

chunks: ntType": "prd", "sections": {"problem": "Finance reconciles part-payments by hand because `parseInvoice` in src/invoices.ts treats every payment as settling one invoice in full. A payment covering two invoices lands against the first and leaves the second open.", "outcome": "A payment can be split across invoices at the point it is recorded, and the reconciliation queue is empty at the end of a working day rather than at the end of a week."}}

sections.problem: Finance reconciles part-payments by hand because `parseInvoice` in src/invoices.ts treats every payment as settling one invoice in full. A payment covering two invoices lands against the first and leaves the second open.
sections.outcome: A payment can be split across invoices at the point it is recorded, and the reconciliation queue is empty at the end of a working day rather than at the end of a week.
